select id, start_at, end_at, booking_date, start_time, end_time, party_size, status, customer_name, customer_email, created_at
      from public.bookings
      where restaurant_id = $1
        and start_at >= $2
        and start_at < $3
        and (customer_name ilike $6 or customer_email ilike $6)
      order by start_at desc
      limit $4 offset $5

select id, start_at, end_at, booking_date, start_time, end_time, party_size, status, customer_name, customer_email, created_at
      from public.bookings
      where restaurant_id = $1
        and start_at >= $2
        and start_at < $3
      order by start_at desc
      limit $4 offset $5

select b.id, b.status, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.party_size, b.customer_name, b.reference,
             a.table_id, t.table_number, t.capacity, t.section
      from public.bookings b
      left join public.booking_table_assignments a on a.booking_id = b.id
      left join public.table_inventory t on t.id = a.table_id
      where b.restaurant_id = $1
        and b.booking_date = $2
      order by b.start_time asc
select count(*)::int as n from public.bookings where restaurant_id=$1 and reference like $2
select count(*)::int as n from public.customers where restaurant_id=$1 and email like $2

select
          min(booking_date)::text as min,
          max(booking_date)::text as max
        from public.bookings
        where reference like $1
select count(*) as customers_count from public.customers
select count(*)::int as total, count(*) filter (where start_at is null)::int as null_start_at from public.bookings
select count(*) as bookings_count from public.bookings

select
      (select count(*)::bigint from public.restaurants) as restaurants,
      (select count(*)::bigint from public.table_inventory) as table_inventory,
      (select count(*)::bigint from public.table_adjacencies) as table_adjacencies,
      (select count(*)::bigint from public.customers) as customers,
      (select count(*)::bigint from public.bookings) as bookings,
      (select count(*)::bigint from public.booking_table_assignments) as assignments
select count(*) as booking_table_assignments_count from public.booking_table_assignments
